tagline: 柯达盒式相机，1954 年发布
description: 柯达于1954年推出的盒式相机。配备Kodak Twindar, zone-focusing。快门速度rotary, with flash synch; Speeds "Long" (bulb) or "Instant"。使用620 film, 8 6x9cm exposures。

specs.快门: rotary, with flash synch; Speeds "Long" (bulb) or "Instant"
specs.英文简介: The Brownie Bull's-Eye was a Bakelite Box camera taking 8 6x9 exposures on 620 film, made by Kodak between 1954 & 1960.
